violations.type: Keyboard accessibility – actions not operable via keyboard
violations.affected_code: Focus(onKeyEvent: _handleKey, ...) / onTapUp: (details) => details.localPosition.dx < dividerX ? widget.onTapReference?.call() : widget.onTapPhoto?.call()
violations.explanation: Opening the reference or photo (onTapReference/onTapPhoto) is only available through pointer taps and through custom semantics actions for screen readers. _handleKey handles only the left and right arrow keys, so keyboard-only users can focus the component but cannot open either image (e.g. with Enter/Space or other keys).

The visible corner labels identifying the reference and photo use a very small 11px font on a semi-transparent background over arbitrary image content, which may be hard to read for low-vision users. Contrast depends on the underlying image.
